title: JRN-007 Happy Path: SME Term Loan — Enquiry to Drawdown
description: Full happy-path flow from initial RM conversation through credit assessment, committee approval, facility agreement execution, and CHAPS drawdown to the business account. Credit assessment request and completion cross the CAP-002/CAP-004 boundary via async events only. Drawdown disbursement crosses CAP-002/CAP-003 via synchronous payment API.
